A motion was made by Commissioner Wheeler, seconded by Commissioner
Marsh, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.

A substitute motion was made by Commissioner Coffee, seconded by
Commissioner Gonzales, to receive and file a presentation from City staff on
Extreme Heat and Air Quality and the Climate Action Plan, and request Office
of Climate Action & Sustainability staff to write a letter from the Climate
Resilient and Sustainable City Commission to City Manager, Mayor and City
Council, to include the following elements discussed in the presentation:
work with Energy Resources, Long Beach Transit and Harbor Department to
direct grant funding resources for additional assessments and mapping;
community outreach and instruction to cooling centers; consider rebates for
residents that purchase energy efficient air conditioning equipment; and
provide a results dashboard on other air quality and extreme heat measures
to track progress on the City’s website. The motion carried by the following
vote:

Yes:  7  Bergeron-Birge, Coffee, Gaines, Gonzales, Marsh, Tolkoff, Gaytan
No:  1  Wheeler
Recused: 0  None
Abstain: 0  None
Absent: 1  Kunihiro
